cv.name: Jonas Freitag
cv.headline: Account Executive Mid-Market | B2B SaaS | Former Customer Success Manager
cv.summary: Seven years in Berlin B2B SaaS, split between closing new business and keeping customers successful. I started as an SDR, spent two years in customer success and now sell workflow software to mid-market companies in DACH.

experience.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market DACH
bullets: Full-cycle sales to companies with 200–2,000 employees; average deal size €38k ARR
Closed 124% of quota in 2024 and 109% in 2025
Run discovery, demos and procurement negotiations with IT, works councils and purchasing
Built a partner referral motion with two implementation agencies

experience.title: Customer Success Manager
bullets: Managed a book of 70 SMB accounts; net revenue retention of 112%
Wrote the churn-risk playbook still used by the team

experience.title: Sales Development Representative
bullets: Outbound prospecting in German and English; booked 25+ meetings per month

education.school: HWR Berlin – Berlin School of Economics and Law
